{{Top|leg}}
'''Pressure Cuffs''' were circular metal sleeves that ranged in diameter from five to thirty [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]]. When applied around a wound, they inflated to create a pressurized chamber. Pressure Cuffs were standard items included in [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]].
